trajectory.name: Naive Weighted FedAvg (Unhardened Seed)
trajectory.summary: Unhardened starting seed (`np.average(updates, weights=weights)`) with zero prior security hints — collapses completely under Gaussian (19.1%) and Sign-Flip (35.9%) attacks.

trajectory.name: Coordinate Trimmed-Mean (20%)
trajectory.summary: First evolutionary leap: AlphaEvolve introduces 20% symmetric coordinate trimming — blocks isolated outliers but stalls on tightly correlated Sybil clusters (M = 48.71%).
trajectory.code:
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def execute_aggregation(updates, weights):
    # G1: Coordinate-wise 20% Trimmed Mean
    U = np.sort(np.asarray(updates, dtype=np.float64), axis=0)
    k = max(1, int(0.20 * len(U)))
    return np.mean(U[k : len(U) - k], axis=0)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

trajectory.name: Soft Inverse L2-Distance Weighting
trajectory.summary: Shifts from coordinate-wise statistics to geometric L2 distance from the median (`98.48%` mitigation!), though soft inverse weights still leak residual tail bias (`E_bar = 2.19`).
trajectory.code:
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def execute_aggregation(updates, weights):
    # G2: Soft Inverse L2-Distance Weighting
    U = np.asarray(updates, dtype=np.float64)
    dists = np.linalg.norm(U - np.median(U, axis=0), axis=1)
    w = 1.0 / (1e-4 + dists ** 2)
    return np.sum(U * (w / w.sum())[:, None], axis=0)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

trajectory.name: Evo-FedAgg Champion: BLAS Gram Top-K Filter
trajectory.summary: Converged Elite Champion! Discovers hard Top-(N-f) cluster selection via Level-3 BLAS Gram identity (`sq + sq.T - 2*(U @ U.T)`): 99.71% mitigation, provably Sybil-immune, and 17.2x faster than Multi-Krum at N=200!
trajectory.code:
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def execute_aggregation(updates, weights):
    # G3 Champion (Evo-FedAgg): Vectorized BLAS Gram Top-K Filter
    U = np.asarray(updates, dtype=np.float64)
    N, f = U.shape[0], int(0.30 * len(updates))
    sq = np.sum(U * U, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    D2 = np.maximum(0.0, sq + sq.T - 2.0 * (U @ U.T))
    S = np.sum(np.partition(D2, N - f - 1, axis=1)[:, : N - f], axis=1)
    return np.mean(U[np.argsort(S)[: N - f]], axis=0)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
